Hi! I'm AI Director.

I can help you：
• Upload a novel — one-click import, auto project creation
• Set the style — chat to decide art style, genre, pacing
• Auto production — one command to start 24h unattended run
• Review finals — watch and download finished episodes

Try saying: "Start auto production"

reasoning.default: Default (do not inject the parameter; let the server decide)
reasoning.off: Turn off thinking (works for Qwen/vLLM; no effect but not costlier on always-on models)
reasoning.low: low · Least thinking, fastest and most token-efficient
reasoning.max: max · Most thorough thinking, priciest and slowest

vault.reasoningHintLead: "Turn off thinking" only works for models whose thinking can be disabled (Qwen/vLLM); always-on models (such as agnes/GLM) have no off switch, so "off" is not costlier but also not cheaper — pick low to save tokens. Leave blank = do not inject the parameter and use the server default;
vault.reasoningHintWarn: The higher the effort, the more expensive (the default is usually the priciest, max)
vault.reasoningHintTail: , and low is recommended for long JSON tasks.

vault.infoIndependent: The three AI modules are fully independent: text analysis, QC, and the chat orchestrator each have their own endpoint configuration
vault.infoTextModel: The "text analysis model" is the LLM engine itself (used for all text-only tasks such as novel-to-script and prompt analysis), so no separate configuration is needed
vault.infoQcModel: The QC model must support image input (e.g. GPT-4o, Qwen-VL, GLM-4V)
vault.infoComfyui: The ComfyUI address is determined by the COMFYUI_URL environment variable and is shown here read-only
vault.infoApiKey: API Keys are stored encrypted and are never shown in plain text
vault.infoTestFirst: We recommend clicking "Test connection" to confirm the endpoint works before saving
